g.title: Aldol addition event 1
g.desc: CH₃CHO + HO⁻ ⇌ ⁻CH₂CHO + H₂O Base → alpha H; C–H pair → alpha C in the C-anion enolate contributor; resonance is not a new event.

g.text: Base → alpha H; C–H pair → alpha C in the C-anion enolate contributor; resonance is not a new event.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Aldol addition event 2
g.desc: ⁻CH₂CHO + CH₃CHO → CH₃CH(O⁻)CH₂CHO Enolate alpha C → second aldehyde C; acceptor C=O π pair → O. Enolate carbonyl remains.

g.text: Enolate alpha C → second aldehyde C; acceptor C=O π pair → O. Enolate carbonyl remains.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Aldol addition event 3
g.desc: CH₃CH(O⁻)CH₂CHO + H₂O ⇌ CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CHO + HO⁻ Alkoxide O → water H; water O–H pair → O. Hydroxide is regenerated; no stereoisomer selected.

g.text: Alkoxide O → water H; water O–H pair → O. Hydroxide is regenerated; no stereoisomer selected.
